Shadewright {{ .Chart.AppVersion }} is installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} get deployments

Cluster ID (hashed into every Incident fingerprint): {{ include "shadewright.clusterId" . }}
{{- if not .Values.clusterId }} (the UID of the kube-system namespace; keep it: a change starts every Incident afresh){{ end }}

Next:
{{- if not .Values.analyzer.watchNamespaces }}
  - The analyzer watches no namespace (analyzer.watchNamespaces is empty), so it reads no events or pods and
    records no Incident. To watch some, upgrade with the list, for example:

      helm upgrade {{ .Release.Name }} <chart> -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} --reuse-values \
        --set 'analyzer.watchNamespaces={team-a,team-b}'

    The chart creates one read-only RoleBinding in each listed namespace, which must exist.
{{- end }}
{{- if not .Values.settings.create }}
  - Create the RemediationSettings object named "default" (settings.create=true, or apply your own).
{{- end }}
{{- if not .Values.executor.identity.azure.clientId }}
  - executor.identity.azure.clientId is not set: the executor has no Azure workload identity, so it cannot reach
    Key Vault to sign for the GitHub App, and a request that reaches the Git step stays Pending.
{{- end }}
{{- if and .Values.metrics.enabled .Values.metrics.secure }}
  - Metrics are scraped only from namespaces labeled "metrics: enabled", by an identity allowed to "get" the
    non-resource URL /metrics (the ClusterRole {{ include "shadewright.resourceName" (dict "suffix" "metrics-reader" "context" $) }}; nothing binds it).
{{- end }}
{{- if not (include "shadewright.verifierWatchNamespaces" . | fromJsonArray) }}
  - The verifier watches no namespace (verifier.watchNamespaces is null and analyzer.watchNamespaces is empty,
    or verifier.watchNamespaces is empty), so it reads no pod and a remediation cannot be verified. Set
    verifier.watchNamespaces to a list, or analyzer.watchNamespaces, which it follows while it is null.
{{- end }}
{{- if or (not .Values.executor.image.digest) (not .Values.analyzer.image.digest) (not .Values.verifier.image.digest) }}
  - An image has no digest, so it runs by the tag {{ .Chart.AppVersion }} (image.allowTag=true, a source
    checkout). The chart published on a release tag pins the release's signed digests; set
    executor.image.digest, analyzer.image.digest and verifier.image.digest to pin them here.
{{- end }}
{{- if not .Values.networkPolicy.enabled }}

WARNING: networkPolicy.enabled=false. The chart installed no NetworkPolicy at all, so the default deny for the
namespace is gone too: every Pod in {{ .Release.Namespace }} can send and receive any traffic unless you restrict it yourself.
{{- end }}
{{- if not .Values.metrics.secure }}

WARNING: metrics.secure=false. The metrics endpoint serves plain HTTP with no authentication. Use it only for a test.
{{- end }}
